title: Uwo wakuwe mu igeragezwa ry'amazi
intro: Mu nkuru z’amateka y’ibyanditswe bya kera, hari umuntu utangaje inkuru ye idatangirana n’igitangaza gikomeye cyangwa ihishurwa rikomeye, ahubwo itangirana n’ikigeragezo cyoroshye ariko gikomeye cy’ukwizera. Igihugu cyari gihagaze ku nzira y’amahuriro, gishaka ubuyobozi bw’Imana. Icyagaragaye ni ikizamini cy’ubwenge ku buryo cyahishuye abizera nyakuri muri bo. Ese ushobora guhishura iri banga uhereye ku bimenyetso byasigaye?
clues: Nakomokaga mu muryango abantu bakunda, kandi Allah yantoye ku bw'umugambi mutagatifu batashoboraga gusobanukirwa.
Umubiri wanjye wari ufite ikimenyetso cy'icyubahiro abandi baburaga, bituma ngaragara nk'umuntu utandukanye n'abandi.
Ubwo uruzi rwatangazwaga ko ari rwo rugero, abenshi basubiye inyuma—ariko nakomeje imbere, nyobowe no kwizera gukomeye isezerano rya Allah.
Nategetswe kutanywa amazi abujijwe, ariko igitonyanga kimwe cyavuye mu kanwa kanjye—icyaha cyahoraga gihangayikisha umutima wanjye.
Imana yanteguriye guhura n'umushumba ukiri muto wari kuzaba icyamamare mu kwica umwanzi ukomeye.
Ubwo ingabo zarwanaga, sinaguye mu maboko y'umwanzi, ahubwo naguye mu gihano cy'Imana kubera kutumvira kwanjye ku ruzi.

arabic: فَلَمَّا فَصَلَ طَالُوتُ بِٱلْجُنُودِ قَالَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُبْتَلِيكُم بِنَهَرٍۢ فَمَن شَرِبَ مِنْهُ فَلَيْسَ مِنِّى وَمَن لَّمْ يَطْعَمْهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنِّىٓ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱغْتَرَفَ غُرْفَةًۢ بِيَدِهِۦ ۚ فَشَرِبُوا۟ مِنْهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا مِّنْهُمْ ۚ فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَهُۥ هُوَ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ قَالُوا۟ لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِجَالُوتَ وَجُنُودِهِۦ ۚ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَظُنُّونَ أَنَّهُم مُّلَـٰقُوا۟ ٱللَّهِ كَم مِّن فِئَةٍۢ قَلِيلَةٍ غَلَبَتْ فِئَةًۭ كَثِيرَةًۢ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ مَعَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And when Saul went forth with the soldiers, he said, "Indeed, Allāh will be testing you with a river. So whoever drinks from it is not of me, and whoever does not taste it is indeed of me, excepting one who takes [from it] in the hollow of his hand." But they drank from it, except a [very] few of them. Then when he had crossed it along with those who believed with him, they said, "There is no power for us today against Goliath and his soldiers." But those who were certain that they would meet Allāh said, "How many a small company has overcome a large company by permission of Allāh. And Allāh is with the patient." (2:249)
